We wanted to ask you about the club's treasure!
Xiaoyao: Back in the day (1000 words omitted)... the treasure is right here in Safehaven. I have a map and a master key. Find something for me and they're yours.

Xiaoyao: Whoa, what's that thing coming out? Bye-bye! #%$#%$%$$ I'm outta here!
What a coward. Fine, I'll deal with you lot myself.
Demon Guard: How did the three of you get in here?
Demon Guard: Hey! Are you kidding me! I'm not the...... I'm just training to become a demon.
DAMN! You're really fighting! Then I'll go all out!
Haha! I've mastered it! I was going easy on you! Time for my ultimate move!
The Demon Guard wiped you out! No Demon Cave for you, so no going back to the real world~~
Talk, Archdemon! Who are you really?
The demon has breathed its last.
Haha! The demon had loot on him!
I am the Nether Guard. Who says you can't take it with you?
No money? Then stay in the underworld forever.
Since this is the demo version, we'll send you straight to floor 1!
I am the Fiend Emperor! The true master of the Demonspire!
These are just the ordinary disciples' quarters. Better not go in.
Welcome, Master! I have top-grade medicine here! A discount for you, of course.
Huh??! This girl looks really familiar. Who is she?
Miss, may I ask who you are......
Get lost! Disturb me and you die!
Boo-hoo-hoo~~ What are you bandits doing in my room?
......Well, if it isn't Zhao Bingyan! Haha! Fancy meeting you here!
Who are you? How do you know me???
Heh! So you found my time machine too? Using my stuff behind my back isn't nice! This is what you get! Let's see you get home now!
So it's YOU! Send me back right now!
Serves you right for touching my time machine!
What are you two talking about? I don't understand a word!
Well...... how do I explain this?
If it's hard to explain, never mind.
Then I guess I'm stuck with you lot. (bitter smile)
Remember, you asked for it. (snicker) Huh??? What's that you're wearing?
You can do that? Where'd you steal that skill from? Talk!
It's my family's secret art - Equipment Forging!
You look so pitiful... Fine. Bring me a piece of Prism Silk and I'll teach you.
There, now you've learned it. Mull it over for a year and you'll grasp its secrets.
You don't have the cloth? How am I supposed to teach you? Forget it, I didn't want to tell anyone anyway.

Cash Potential Battle-EXP EXP Strength Agility Intellect Luck

SORRY, you don't have enough money. Come back next time.
